slides.title: Positioning & Price
bullets: Recommendation: “A Pune cold-pressed juice subscription with clear per-juice pricing and a week of choice or planned variety.”
Recommended price: ₹699 for a seven-day plan of one juice per day (about ₹100 per juice); this is a recommendation, not a verified price.
Specify serving size and delivery terms before sale; confirm serviceable areas before advertising them.
slides.notes: The positioning and price are recommendations in the report. The proposed price is not a verified market price; serving size and delivery terms remain to be specified.

slides.title: 30-Day Launch Plan
bullets: Week 1: Confirm feasibility, service areas, serving size and delivery terms; decide choice or rotation; validate the proposed ₹699 test price.
Week 2: Prepare an offer page with price, serving size, schedule, choice/rotation and service area; invite a small test group and adjust from feedback.
Week 3: Run a limited pilot with consenting customers in confirmed areas; track orders, repeat intent, delivery reliability and reported feedback.
Week 4: Review pilot and test-price response; revise the offer based on results and feasibility; expand promotion only where coverage and terms are confirmed.
slides.notes: These are proposed actions from the report's launch plan, not claims about completed research or existing operations.
